log_file.description: Path to the log file; use 'stderr' to log to console.

rpc_transport_url.description: Connection URL for the RPC transport (e.g., RabbitMQ).

rpc_conn_pool_size.description: Size of the RPC connection pool.

sink_host.description: Interface/IP to bind the sink service to.

sink_port.description: Port for receiving DNS update notifications (RFC 2136-style).

sink_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the sink service.

sink_enable_zone_management.description: Whether the sink should manage zones on incoming updates.

sink_service_name.description: Service name used when registering with OpenStack services.

rpc_api_version.description: API version for RPC communication with central.

notifier_exchange.description: AMQP exchange name for event notifications.

notifier_topics.description: Topics to publish DNS update notifications to.

items.description: AMQP topic name for a notification channel.

keystone_project_domain.description: Keystone domain name for the service project.

keystone_project_name.description: Keystone project (tenant) name for the service user.

keystone_user_domain.description: Keystone domain name for the service user.

keystone_service_username.description: Keystone username for the Designate service.

keystone_service_password.description: Password for the Designate service user in Keystone (secure in production).

keystone_insecure.description: Whether to skip SSL/TLS certificate verification (dangerous in production).
